text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Qatar welcomes a call by Bahrain's crown prince for unity between Qatar and Bahrain. The two countries are locked in a dispute over Gulf islands.
- Bahrain-based Arab Insurance Group will offer new shares to investors in two months and hopes to raise $200 million in capital.
- Cabinet discusses plans to develop Bahrain's industry.
- The world's first comprehensive databank on Islamic banks and financial institutions is launched by the Bahrain-based Islamic Investment Company of the Gulf.
- A British trade team and Bahraini officials discuss ways of boosting cooperation between the two countries.
